KYC_PROMPT.TEXT:
To start using 3rike Pay, we need to verify your identity.

This takes less than 2 minutes. Tap the button below to begin.

KYC_COMPLETE.TEXT:
Identity verified successfully!

You can now:
- Send money to any bank
- Check your balance

Tap *Start* to begin.

KYC_CHOOSE_ID.TEXT: Which ID would you like to verify with?
KYC_CHOOSE_ID.INVALID_NUMBER: A {{idType}} is exactly 11 digits. Please check and enter it again:

KYC_OTP.PROMPT:
We've sent a code to the phone number registered to your ID.

Enter the code here to finish setting up your account.
KYC_OTP.INVALID:
That code doesn't look right. Enter the code sent to the phone number registered to your BVN.

Type *cancel* to stop.
KYC_OTP.RETRY:
That code wasn't accepted. Check it and try again - {{left}} {{leftPlural}} left.

Type *cancel* to stop.
KYC_OTP.FAILED:
We couldn't verify that code: {{reason}}

Type *kyc* to start over, or *help* if you're stuck.

KYC_FLOW_WAITING.TEXT:
Your verification form is still open - please continue there to finish setting up your wallet.

Type *cancel* if you want to stop and start over.

MAIN_MENU.TEXT: What would you like to do?

SEND_MONEY.PROMPT_BANK:
Type the recipient's bank name.

Examples: *GTBank*, *Opay*, *Moniepoint*, *Kuda*
SEND_MONEY.PROMPT_ACCOUNT: Enter the recipient's account number (10 digits):
SEND_MONEY.INVALID_AMOUNT: That doesn't look like a valid amount. Enter a number of at least {{min}} (e.g. 5000).
SEND_MONEY.AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE: That amount is above the {{max}} per-transfer limit. Enter a smaller amount.
SEND_MONEY.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE:
Insufficient balance.

You want to send {{amount}} but your balance is {{balance}}.

Top up your account or enter a smaller amount.
SEND_MONEY.NO_BANK_MATCH:
No bank matched "{{query}}".

Try a shorter name - e.g. *zenith*, *kuda*, *opay*, *access*.
SEND_MONEY.BANK_MATCHES: Found {{count}} matching bank{{plural}}. Pick the right one:
SEND_MONEY.TOO_MANY_MATCHES: Found {{count}} matching banks - showing the closest 10. If yours isn't here, type more of its name.
SEND_MONEY.CANCELLED: Transfer cancelled. No money was moved.
SEND_MONEY.FAILED:
Transfer failed: {{reason}}

Please try again or contact support.

BUY_AIRTIME.COMING_SOON:
Airtime and data top-ups aren't live yet - we're finishing the integration.

For now you can send money and check your balance. Type *start* for the menu.
BUY_AIRTIME.PROMPT_PHONE: Enter the phone number to recharge:
BUY_AIRTIME.SUCCESS:
Airtime of {{amount}} sent to {{phone}}!

You'll receive a confirmation shortly.

CHECK_BALANCE.ERROR: Could not fetch balance. Please try again later.

TRANSACTIONS.EMPTY:
You haven't made any transactions yet.

Type *start* for menu.
TRANSACTIONS.ERROR: Could not load transactions. Please try again later.

HELP.TEXT:
*3rike Pay Commands*

• *start* or /start - Open main menu
• /balance or /check_balance - Check balance
• /send - Send money
• /transactions - View transactions
• *help* or /help - Show this help
• *cancel* or /cancel - Cancel current action

You can type *cancel* at any point to get out of a flow.

*Features:*
• Send money to any Nigerian bank
• Check balance
• KYC verification

CANCEL: Session cancelled. Send *start* to begin again.

ERROR.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again or type *start* to restart.
ERROR.KYC_FAILED: Verification failed. Please try again or contact support.
